parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance that contains the specified resources.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resources.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:

- **INSTANCE**

- **TOPIC**

- **CONSUMERGROUP**

> The value is case-insensitive.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key.

- The tag key cannot be an empty string.

- The tag key can be up to 128 characters long. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value.

- The tag value can be an empty string.

- The tag value can be up to 128 characters long. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http\:// or https\://.
